cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I used to make you repeat what you'd heard before you answered. I texted 'I've lost my job.' You replied, 'What's for dinner?'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought something normal would help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You skipped the listening part. Can you see why I felt like your cook?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant we could go out. I'll book somewhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait. You've always wanted to move on before we'd finished this part. Tell me why that message sounded like another job for me. Then we can book.

reason: Replace the academic show-your-working metaphor with the established listening sequence; keep B clarification and A need for acknowledgment before practical repair.
